decisions.decision: Load existing config — skip interactive setup
decisions.rationale: .claude/refactor.config.json exists and contains valid JSON with all required fields. No merge with defaults needed.
decisions.outcome: Config loaded: iterations=5, commitStrategy=single-final, createPR=true, prDraft=true, publishReport=none

decisions.decision: Parse --focus=discovery,simplification as two valid focus areas
decisions.rationale: Both 'discovery' and 'simplification' are in the allowed set {security, architecture, simplification, code, discovery}. Split on comma, validated individually.
alternatives_considered: Reject if any invalid (none were invalid)

decisions.decision: Derive active_agents from focus spawn matrix
decisions.rationale: discovery -> code-explorer; simplification -> simplifier; always included: refactor-test, refactor-code. Union of all sets.
alternatives_considered: Spawn all 6 agents (only if --focus not provided)
decisions.outcome: active_agents={code-explorer, simplifier, refactor-test, refactor-code}. Excluded: architect, code-reviewer.

decisions.rationale: Formula: cli_iterations ?? (is_focused ? 1 : config.iterations) ?? 3. No --iterations flag provided (cli_iterations=undefined). is_focused=true, so default is 1. Config.iterations=5 is NOT used because focused runs default to 1.
alternatives_considered: Use default 3 (only if no other value)

decisions.decision: Accept src/utils/helpers.ts as scope despite file not existing
decisions.rationale: The skill spec says to parse remaining arguments as file path if it looks like one. Validation of file existence is the code-explorer's job during Phase 0.5 discovery, not the team lead's job during argument parsing.
Per skill spec Step 0.2.3: create phase tasks. code-explorer is in active_agents so Phase 0.5 is included. max_iterations=1 so only one Phase 2 task.
alternatives_considered: Skip Phase 0.5 task (incorrect, code-explorer is active)
decisions.outcome: Tasks: Phase 0.5, Phase 1, Phase 2 (iter 1 of 1), Phase 3, Phase 4

decisions.rationale: Only agents in active_agents are spawned. architect and code-reviewer are excluded because neither 'architecture', 'code', nor 'security' focus was specified.
decisions.outcome: Spawned: code-explorer, simplifier, refactor-test, refactor-code. Not spawned: architect, code-reviewer.

decisions.decision: Blackboard ID derived from scope slug
decisions.rationale: Skill spec says task_id should be 'refactor-{scope-slug}'. Scope 'src/utils/helpers.ts' slugifies to 'src-utils-helpers-ts'.

decisions.decision: Phase 2 iteration will skip Steps 2.A through 2.E
decisions.rationale: Step 2.A skipped because architect not in active_agents. Step 2.B skipped because 2.A skipped (no plan to implement). Steps 2.C-2.D skipped because 2.B skipped. Step 2.E skipped because code-reviewer not in active_agents. Step 2.F will execute (simplifier is active, operates on scope directly). Step 2.G will execute (verify simplifier changes).
decisions.outcome: Only Steps 2.F, 2.G, 2.H will execute in the iteration loop

decisions.decision: Final commit and PR will be created
decisions.rationale: Config has commitStrategy=single-final and createPR=true with prDraft=true. After Phase 3, a single commit will be made and a draft PR created.
decisions.outcome: Single final commit + draft PR at Phase 4
